patch_list: Removes update prompts and forced updates. Requires Android 10 or later.

Removes ads. Requires Android 10 or later.

patch_list: Lets you choose how far the player skips when seeking, from the player settings.
Hides the blocking update dialog and the update prompt.
Starts videos at the highest available quality instead of 480p.
Makes quality selection work: 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K actually switch to that resolution.
Unlocks VIP-only content and removes region restrictions.
